# VTK Image Interpolation

Also called: vtkImageInterpolator, vtkImageSincInterpolator

## Overview
VTK Image Interpolation is a family of classes in the Visualization Toolkit (VTK) library used to resample volume data into an isotropic grid by retrieving scalar values at arbitrary 3D positions [S1]. It distinguishes itself from sibling methods by providing specific implementations for standard polynomial interpolation (`vtkImageInterpolator`) and windowed sinc approximation (`vtkImageSincInterpolator`), allowing users to balance computational cost against spectral fidelity during volume resampling [S1].

## Shared principles
The family operates by resampling discrete voxel data into an isotropic grid [S1]. `vtkImageSincInterpolator` approximates sinc interpolation by multiplying the sinc function with a window function to limit the kernel size [S1]. The kernel is defined as $K(r) = \text{sinc}(r) \cdot W(r)$, where $r$ is the normalized distance from the query point [G]. In Fourier space, the resolution of the spectral window is reduced to the order of the half-width of the sinc function [S1]. The window half-width (WHW) is a parameter addressed in studies with values ranging from 1 to 16 [S1]. Blur factors (BF) in the x, y, and z directions automatically increase the kernel size and computation time, though implementations have tested BF in the z-direction only [S1].

## Subtopics

### vtkImageInterpolator
This is the default interpolator in VTK and provides linear, cubic, and nearest-neighbor interpolation modes [S1].

### vtkImageSincInterpolator
This class approximates sinc interpolation by multiplying the sinc function with a window function to limit kernel size [S1]. It supports the following window functions: Lanczos, Kaiser (adjustment parameter off), Cosine, Hann, Hamming, Blackman, and Nuttall [S1]. Consequently, the quality of sinc interpolation depends on both the window function type and the window half-width (WHW), which ranges from 1 to 16 [S1]. Additionally, it supports blur factors (BF) in x, y, and z directions to blur data during interpolation, which automatically increases the kernel size and computation time [S1].

## Background
The VTK Image Interpolation classes are part of the Visualization Toolkit (VTK), a C++ software library for 3D computer graphics, image processing, and visualization [S1]. The specific classes `vtkImageInterpolator` and `vtkImageSincInterpolator` were utilized in research for optimizing breast tomosynthesis visualization through 3D volume rendering, where volume data was resampled into an isotropic grid [S1]. The implementation relies on internal VTK mechanisms for data interpolation [S1]. The study of these interpolators involved testing various window functions and parameters, including the window half-width (WHW) and blur factors, to determine optimal resampling strategies for medical imaging data [S1]. The default sampling distance used in these studies was 1.0 mm [S1].
